question: Assume today is 2026-08-29. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the total freight carried by Canadian railways in July 2026, in tonnes, as it will be first reported by Statistics Canada in its monthly Railway carloadings release (total traffic carried, Canada).

target.what: Total freight carried by Canadian railways in July 2026, as first reported by Statistics Canada in its monthly Railway carloadings release; working interpretation is Canada-level total revenue-freight tonnage carried during the calendar month, including all commodities and intermodal traffic in the
target.caveats: Target month ended before the 2026-08-29 cutoff, but the official first-reported figure is assumed unavailable at cutoff. 'Total traffic carried' may differ from carload counts, revenue ton-miles, domestic-origin carloadings only, or port throughput. Working interpretation uses the Canada-level publ

candidates.hypothesis: July total tonnage has recurring seasonal patterns and a recent trend; prior July values and Jan-Jun 2026 year-over-year changes constrain July 2026 even without the July print.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly total tonnes carried by Canadian railways for Jan 2023-Jun 2026, especially July 2023, July 2024, July 2025, and May/June 2026; commodity detail if available. Minimum evidence: July 2025 total and any 2026 monthly prints through June.
search_hints: Statistics Canada railway carloadings July 2025 total tonnes
Table 23-10-0086-01 railway carloadings monthly Canada
Railway carloadings Canada June 2026 Statistics Canada

candidates.hypothesis: July 2026 total tonnes can be reconstructed from weekly carloads by commodity multiplied by average payloads; weekly carloads are an early indicator of the monthly total.
candidates.data_to_find: Weekly Canadian railway carloads and/or tonnage for weeks covering July 2026, by commodity where possible; CN and CPKC weekly operating metrics; AAR or industry weekly rail data. Minimum evidence: at least partial July 2026 weekly carloads by commodity, or total weekly carloads.
search_hints: July 2026 weekly railway carloadings Canada
Canadian railways carloads week ending July 2026
Ag Transport Coalition weekly rail carloads July 2026

candidates.hypothesis: Total rail tonnage is the sum of major commodity flows (grain, coal, potash, crude oil, forest products, metals, intermodal); July 2026 export/production indicators for these commodities plus rail shares can approximate most of the total, with a residual allowance.
candidates.data_to_find: July 2026 Canadian rail/export volumes or production for grain, coal, potash, crude oil, forest products, metals, and containerized intermodal; rail modal shares by commodity. Minimum evidence: July 2026 grain, coal, potash, and oil rail/export flows plus an intermodal indicator.
search_hints: Canada grain rail shipments July 2026
Canada potash rail shipments July 2026
Canada coal exports July 2026 rail

candidates.hypothesis: Rail-served export throughput at major Canadian ports is a large identifiable component of total rail tonnage; port July 2026 cargo by rail plus an allowance for domestic and transborder traffic constrains the total.
candidates.data_to_find: July 2026 cargo throughput at Vancouver, Prince Rupert, Montreal, Halifax and other rail-served ports by commodity (grain, coal, potash, containers), plus rail modal share at each port. Minimum evidence: July 2026 grain/coal/potash rail-served port volumes and container rail lift counts.
search_hints: Port of Vancouver July 2026 grain rail shipments
Prince Rupert port July 2026 coal grain volumes
Montreal Halifax port July 2026 rail cargo

candidates.hypothesis: Realised tonnage is constrained by loaded-car capacity, loaded-car utilisation, train starts, and operating days; July 2026 operating metrics such as car miles, average train weight, and loaded cars track the tonnage level.
candidates.data_to_find: July 2026 weekly or monthly operating metrics for Canadian railways: train starts, car miles, average train tonnage, loaded cars, dwell, locomotive availability; CN/CPKC earnings or operating reports if available by cutoff. Minimum evidence: any July 2026 carload or car-mile metric for Canadian operations.
search_hints: CN Rail July 2026 carloads revenue ton miles
CPKC July 2026 carloads operating metrics
Canadian railway operating metrics July 2026

candidates.hypothesis: Non-export domestic rail tonnage relates to Canadian industrial shipments by sector multiplied by rail mode share; July 2026 manufacturing, mining, and agricultural marketings constrain the domestic component.
candidates.data_to_find: July 2026 or latest Canadian manufacturing shipments, mining production, forestry output, and farm marketings; rail mode share by sector in tonnes. Minimum evidence: June/July 2026 industrial shipment index or sector output and a recent rail share estimate.
search_hints: Statistics Canada manufacturing shipments July 2026
Canada mining production July 2026
rail mode share Canada freight tonnes by commodity

candidates.hypothesis: Carload counts convert to tonnes via commodity-specific average payloads and intermodal TEU weights; these parameters bridge weekly carload evidence to the tonnage target.
candidates.data_to_find: Average tonnes per carload by commodity for Canadian railways, loaded/empty car ratios, average intermodal container payload, and any recent changes in payload mix. Minimum evidence: average payload for grain, coal, potash, oil, and intermodal.
search_hints: average tonnes per railcar Canada grain coal potash
intermodal rail container average tonnes Canada
Statistics Canada railway carloadings average weight per car

candidates.hypothesis: July 2026 tonnage may deviate from seasonal baseline because of wildfires, labour disruptions, port closures, tariffs, or grain harvest timing; dated events up to the cutoff can adjust the baseline directionally or quantitatively.
candidates.data_to_find: Dated July 2026 Canadian railway disruptions, wildfire closures, strikes, port outages, trade policy changes, and any quantified rail impact; grain harvest timing relative to normal. Minimum evidence: confirmed event dates and any reported carload or tonnage impact.
search_hints: Canada railway disruption July 2026
wildfires rail Canada July 2026
CPKC CN strike July 2026

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
